features.name: Single front door
features.description: the owner talks to one agent (Tasuke) over Telegram/LINE; Tasuke delegates everything else.
features.notes: Only agent the owner addresses directly. Telegram @HattoriTasukeBot.

features.name: Permission firewall (TALK / DO / PRIVATE)
features.description: Anyone in an allowed chat can trigger conversational TALK actions; only the owner can trigger state-changing DO actions; private info is never revealed in group chats.
features.notes: First-match gate evaluation in TOOLS.md; sender.id == the owner for DO.

features.name: Capabilities wired as text, not code
features.description: New skills are added by editing TOOLS.md and restarting the gateway — no bot or webhook to write.
features.notes: Gateway LLM reads the 1,200-line TOOLS.md playbook every turn.

features.name: Language-matched replies & refusals
features.description: Tasuke replies (and politely refuses) in the language the requester wrote in (pt / en / es / ja / fr).
features.notes: Refusal templates in TOOLS.md global context rules.

features.name: Twice-daily news briefing
features.description: Curated multi-category news digest delivered to Telegram at 6AM and 6PM.
features.notes: RSS aggregation with de-duplication, clustering, and source-credibility policy.

features.name: Dedicated AI/ML digest
features.description: Separate twice-daily digest focused on AI and technology news.
features.notes: Four Task Scheduler jobs total (news + AI, 6AM + 6PM).

features.name: Public news web page
features.description: News digest published to a web page reachable on the phone at a permanent URL.
features.notes: https://kaze.quiddityinnovations.com (QI_KazeNewsTunnel named tunnel).

features.name: Self-service feed configuration
features.description: Add or edit news sources and source policy through a small web UI.
features.notes: Served by QI_KazeConfigAPI at /kaze-config/.

features.name: Archive to NotebookLM
features.description: Digests are pushed into a NotebookLM notebook as a durable knowledge base.
features.notes: Auth-cookie client; Sentry monitors push success.

features.name: Inbox triage & summary
features.description: Fetches Gmail twice daily, classifies, summarises, and delivers a digest with urgent items flagged.
features.notes: maia.quiddam@gmail.com via IMAP; 8AM + 6PM.

features.name: Spam / newsletter suppression
features.description: Marketing, no-reply, and subscription traffic are suppressed so only what matters surfaces.
features.notes: Containment policy in YUBIN.md.

features.name: Hard authority guardrails
features.description: Never authorises subscriptions, contracts, purchases, or consent on the owner's behalf — uncertain mail is escalated.
features.notes: Auto-reply only for approved message classes.

features.name: VIP fast lane
features.description: Mail from named VIPs (e.g. family) is prioritised and called out.
features.notes: Code ready; needs yubin-vip.json allowlist populated.

features.name: One-message daily briefing
features.description: A single 7AM Telegram message combining news, inbox, system health, QI Hive health, calendar, and bills due.
features.notes: Each section degrades gracefully if a data source is missing.

features.name: QI ecosystem health line
features.description: Pulls QI Hive Brain status so the owner sees ecosystem health each morning.
features.notes: Fixed 2026-06-15 to call Brain at :9011 (was dead 9010).

features.name: Today's calendar
features.description: Lists the day's events at the top of the briefing.
features.notes: Code fixed 2026-06-15; needs CALENDAR_ICS_URL secret to activate.

features.name: Automatic bill capture from email
features.description: Bill/statement/invoice emails Yubin classifies are extracted into a ledger (payee, amount, due date).
features.notes: yubin-daily.sh hooks kakei-from-yubin.py after classification.

features.name: Receipt photo capture
features.description: Send a receipt photo to Tasuke; OCR extracts payee/amount/date into the expenses ledger.
features.notes: Skill built; depends on Tasuke photo handler + qwen3-vl vision model.

features.name: Weekly spending summary
features.description: Sunday 7PM Telegram rollup of bills due and the week's spending by category.
features.notes: OC-Kakei-Weekly-Sunday-7PM task; SQLite ledger.

features.name: Never pays anything
features.description: Kakei only records; the owner marks bills paid manually.
features.notes: Authority guardrail by design.

features.name: Voice-note understanding
features.description: Send Tasuke a Telegram voice note; Koe transcribes it locally and Tasuke acts on the text.
features.notes: whisper.cpp, processed on-machine — nothing leaves the device.

features.name: Spoken replies
features.description: Tasuke can reply with a natural voice note in the language of the reply.
features.notes: edge-tts neural voices (default); female persona, language-matched preamble.

features.name: Offline voice fallback
features.description: Falls back to local Piper TTS when the online voice service is unavailable.
features.notes: koe-tts-router.py selects engine via KOE_TTS_ENGINE.

features.name: GPU voice cloning (dots.tts)
features.description: One reference voice speaks across languages as the same person.
features.notes: Parked disabled — reliable for EN/ZH only; PT/JA route to edge.

features.name: Daily system health verdict
features.description: Checks gateway, Ollama, disk, memory, config integrity, and ports, producing a green/amber/red verdict.
features.notes: Deterministic bash — no LLM by design. WSL cron 6AM.

features.name: NotebookLM auth & push monitoring
features.description: Verifies the NotebookLM cookie is valid and that Kaze/Yubin pushes succeeded.
features.notes: Surfaces as warnings in the daily report + dashboard JSON.

features.name: Weekly compliance drift check
features.description: Reads QI Hive Inspector reports and flags standards drift.
features.notes: Sunday 8PM; exits silently if Inspector reports are absent.

features.name: Multi-channel (Telegram + LINE)
features.description: Agents reachable over both Telegram and LINE accounts.
features.notes: tasuke-line + naya-line + kaze-line accounts added since April.

features.name: QI Hive Brain integration
features.description: Tasuke can query the QI Hive Brain for ecosystem status, project state, pending features, and semantic answers.
features.notes: tasuke-hive-skill.py against Brain :9011.

features.name: Cross-bot conversation bridge
features.description: Sibling bots (Maia, Naya, Kaze) can talk across the Telegram bot-to-bot barrier, with a loop guard.
features.notes: Receiver running; candidate channel for Maia⇄OC delegation.

features.name: Proactive broadcast
features.description: Push news/briefings proactively into multiple approved group chats.
features.notes: Built with admin/discover/schedule/send + loop guard; tasks disabled until wanted.

features.name: Maia ⇄ OpenClaw action routing
features.description: Maia recognises an actionable request in conversation and hands it to OpenClaw to execute.
features.notes: Marriage candidate; peer-bridge is the candidate transport.
